# Economy Plus

Economy Plus is an air conditioning and heating repair shop in Northridge, California.
We have served Northridge and the San Fernando Valley since 1989.
We repair and install air conditioners, furnaces, heat pumps, mini-splits, package units, and evaporator coils, in all makes and models.
We specialize in gravity heaters, wall furnaces, and floor heaters.
Our shop is at 8818 Reseda Blvd., #2, Northridge, CA 91324.
Our phone number is (818) 349-2700.
Our email is jimdelrosario@yahoo.com.
Our California state licence number is 578422.
Estimates are free and seniors get a discount.
Call or email to request service.
